sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Rajesh Maurya
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vinod Diwakar,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. By means of the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C., the applicant has sought for a suitable direction to the learned Additional District Judge-VIth, Azamgarh to decide the Sessions Trial No.425 of 2011 titled State v. Naseem, arising out of Case Crime No.190 of 2007, under sections 307, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC and section 7 of Criminal Law Amendment Act, Police Station Phulpur, District Azamgarh within stipulated time.

3. It has been argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that the proceeding of this case is pending since 2007, but till date no witness has been examined; the court has issued non-bailable warrants many times to the witnesses but despite that no witness has turned up to depose.
Learned counsel further submits that a direction may be issued to the concerned Court to decide the same within some specific time frame.

opennyai_summary.arguments:
3. It has been argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that the proceeding of this case is pending since 2007, but till date no witness has been examined; the court has issued non-bailable warrants many times to the witnesses but despite that no witness has turned up to depose.

opennyai_summary.decision:
The instant application is disposed of with a direction to learned Additional District Judge-VIth,
Azamgarh to consider and decide the Sessions Trial No.425 of 2011 titled State v. Naseem, arising out of Case Crime No.190 of 2007, under sections 307, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC and section 7 of Criminal Law Amendment Act, Police Station Phulpur, District Azamgarh, expeditiously in accordance with the roster of the Court.
Further, the court shall not entertain the fictitious and repetitive personal exemption application unless and until application contains the pressing reasons.
The learned trial court is directed to adopt all possible modes to ensure the presence of the witness, and proceed in accordance with law.
